Subject: Billing originator rotation + daily batch cutoff (portal opt-in vs email)

Hi Elaine —

Following up on our conversation last week about who will originate FrostWare invoices going forward. To summarize the options and a suggested schedule: 

1) Portal-first: FrostWare opts into our billing portal (preferred). We push invoices automatically there; AP can pull or receive an email copy. Advantages: structured XML payloads, reliable delivery, and automated VAT tagging.

2) Manual push / email: If you prefer not to opt into the portal right away, Redwood will continue to send PDF invoices by email and can also deliver via SFTP or API (per your AP integration).

Key scheduling detail (a small but important operational constraint): our nightly batch runs have a local cut-off at 23:30 PT to accommodate cross-region sequencing and fraud checks. If you need invoices to appear with a specific account date (e.g., same-day for EOD reconciliation), we’ll need a firm handoff window. We can also offer a daylight-cutoff adjustment for your account to align with FrostWare’s AP timezone (PST vs EST) during the cutover week.

Action items for your team to decide:
- Opt into portal (yes/no) and approximate go-live date
- Preferred invoice delivery: portal only, email copy + portal, or manual PDF push only
- Any PO/field requirements your AP system needs in the invoice header (PO number location, VAT reference)

I’m attaching a sample invoice and a proposed batch-cutoff schedule for review. If you’d like, we can lock a 30-minute call Monday to confirm the handoff and timezone cutoff.

Thanks —

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-2190

Subject: Re: Billing originator rotation + daily batch cutoff (portal opt-in vs email)

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifying questions from AP so we can choose: 

- PO handling: our system requires the PO number to be in the top-level invoice header (not only in the line items). Can Redwood populate a structured PO field?
- VAT evidence: for EU sales we need a VAT registration number printed and a PDF-attached VAT certificate for first invoices. We only need the certificate once per legal entity.
- Cutoff: our AP team operates on EST and prefers invoices dated by 23:59 EST. If your default is 23:30 PT, that would make some invoices appear a day earlier in our ledger — can you do a daylight-cutoff shift during the first week of cutover?

Portal question: FrostWare is open to testing the portal but we’ll need a sandbox for one week before production (to validate PO mapping). If portal onboarding requires DocuSign or an MSA addendum, please point me to the link.

If you can confirm the PO header and provide a sandbox portal link + sample VAT certificate placement, we’ll make a call internally by Monday.

Best,
Elaine Park
AP Manager, FrostWare, Inc.
